stage: Stage 5: external baselines and method applicability boundary
primary_question: Which solver profile should be used under the registered engineering scenarios when solution quality, computation time, feasibility, stability, and engineering mechanism evidence are considered jointly?

interpretation_contract.highs_role: HiGHS-MILP is an external exact optimization backend applied to the same frozen CA-HMCD value model and complete candidate space. A HiGHS advantage is an exact-mode advantage within the framework, not evidence against the value model.
interpretation_contract.fixed_k_role: CA-HMCD denotes the registered K=12 candidate-compression plus bounded branch-and-bound profile.
interpretation_contract.forbidden_claim: No result may be used to claim a universal real-time or universal performance advantage.

Genetic-Algorithm.solver: genetic search with registered evaluation budget

statistical_plan.comparisons: CA-HMCD-FixedK versus each other method, paired within scenario and seed
statistical_plan.interval: deterministic 95% BCa interval for each mean paired difference
statistical_plan.multiplicity: Holm correction separately within scenario and endpoint across four comparators
statistical_plan.bounded_intervals: Wilson intervals for feasibility, coverage, fallback, and deadline-hit proportions
statistical_plan.response_time: computed only on task-periods served by both compared methods
statistical_plan.pareto_rule: A method is nondominated when no other method has both a no-worse mean endpoint and a no-greater mean end-to-end runtime, with at least one strict improvement.

decision_rules.exact_mode_preferred: Recommend CA-HMCD-Exact when HiGHS has higher objective or service quality and its measured runtime satisfies the operational budget.
decision_rules.compressed_mode_retained: Retain CA-HMCD-FixedK only as a bounded-computation profile; do not call it real-time unless the registered Stage-3 Gate B has passed.
decision_rules.lightweight_mode_preferred: Recommend Greedy or Auction only where their runtime advantage is operationally relevant and the reported quality loss is acceptable.
decision_rules.ga_role: Treat GA as a representative external AI/evolutionary baseline; superiority or inferiority is reported without changing the frozen value model.
decision_rules.claim_freeze: The final manuscript claim matrix must be derived from Stage 3, Stage 4, and this Stage 5 without coefficient retuning.
